message.content:
<summary>
Turn 16: Tried IMF SDMX endpoint via curl HEAD to dataservices.imf.org but DNS failed (“Could not resolve host”), so WEO SDMX still unusable from this environment.

Turn 17: Inspected “CFC data” sheet headers/notes. Confirmed Column C header is “Consumption of fixed capital (IDCM.A.N.GE.W2.S1.S1.D.P51C.N1G._T._Z.XDC.V.N)”; Column D is “Capital Stock”; Column E is “Depreciation rate”. Rows start at 1996 with C–E empty.

Turn 18: Verified ECB data-api endpoint for the CFC series works. HEAD request to https://data-api.ecb.europa.eu/service/data/IDCM/A.N.GE.W2.S1.S1.D.P51C.N1G._T._Z.XDC.V.N?...&format=csvdata returned HTTP 200 with content-type text/csv, so CFC data can be pulled programmatically.

Turns 19–27: Attempted to locate/download PWT 11.0 dataset file links from rug.nl PWT pages using curl/grep. The main PWT page HTML contains general content but no visible direct links to .xlsx/.csv/.zip files. Grepping for “download” and file extensions returned nothing useful. Probed likely static URLs under https://www.rug.nl/ggdc/docs/ (pwt110.xlsx/.dta/.zip/.csv etc.) and all returned 404. Checked documentation/earlier releases/additional resources pages; still no file pattern matches. The only .xlsx link found was an unrelated research-paper dataset (gd151_dataset.xlsx), not the PWT database.

Turns 28–30: Tried to locate PWT file URLs via sitemap. rug.nl/sitemap.xml grep for pwt returned nothing; https://www.rug.nl/ggdc/sitemap.xml returned 404, so sitemap approach failed.

No evidence yet of workbook edits/saves; focus remained on connectivity and locating data sources (ECB successful; PWT download link not found; IMF SDMX DNS issue persists).</summary>
